name: naive valuation v1
about: Your summation values. A play's total is the sum of value x factor. Factors are defined in lab/features.js (FACTORS). Values of 0 are factors that are measured but not valued yet; negative values are allowed.

notes.home: Starts h pile = 1.00 in the worked example: full contribution to progressive play. Applied to every play home.
notes.new_column_plays: 0.50 per play set up (Sets up 4Ha in the worked example).
notes.sets_up_reveal: 0.50: Reveals hidden card on b, an immediate consequence of the play.
notes.reveals: 0.50 assumed, the same as setting up a reveal; not in the worked example.
notes.draw_fraction: A full draw is worth 0.50, so 2 of 3 cards = 0.33.
notes.new_home_plays: 0 so the worked example totals 2.83 (2Sh was not counted). Change if a set-up home play should count.
